explanation: States a(24) = 0, i.e. no factorial has exactly 24 sixes in base 10. With the Nat.find/0 convention this is equivalent to that claim, and it matches the OEIS comment ("conjectured that a(24)=0"; the data lists a(24) = 0). The definition of a matches the sequence (a(1) = 3 since 3! = 6). I checked that no k < 3000 has exactly 24 sixes in k!. The statement is faithful and tagged open.
